item.title: Ørsted cancels Hornsea 4 offshore wind project after cost blowout
item.dc:creator: Adnan Bajic
item.content:encoded:
Ørsted said it will stop development of the 2.4 GW Hornsea 4 project off the Yorkshire coast, citing supply chain prices and interest rates that have moved against the project since it won a contract for difference.

The company expects to book impairments of up to DKK 5.5 billion in the second quarter.

The post Ørsted cancels Hornsea 4 appeared first on Offshore Energy.

item.title: EU approves 18th sanctions package targeting Russian LNG transshipment
item.description: The measures ban re-exports of Russian LNG via EU ports from March and lower the oil price cap to $47.60 a barrel.
